newsitem.title: USA: Shell, Mobil see $1.00/barrel savings from venture.
newsitem.headline: Shell, Mobil see $1.00/barrel savings from venture.

text.p: Shell Oil Co, a unit of Royal Dutch/Shell, and Mobil Corp said on Monday that their California upstream joint venture would result in pretax savings of $1.00 per barrel of oil produced.
The companies on Monday signed a formal agreement for the venture, which was first announced in November last year.
The deal comprises the California unit of Mobil Exploration & Producing U.S. Inc. (MEPUS), and California-based CalResources LLC, an affiliate of Shell Oil Co.
Mobil will have a 41.4 percent equity interest in Aera Energy, with Shell holding the remaining 58.6 percent interest, the companies said in a statement.
Daily production from the joint venture, which is called Aera Energy LLC, will be approximately 250,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day and reserves will be some 1.0 billion barrels of oil.
The California oil production operations of Mobil and CalResources are centered in Kern County where the two companies have operated adjacently in the Belridge and Midway Sunset fields.
Mobil's and Shell's California-based refining, retail petroleum products marketing and pipeline operations are not included in Aera Energy. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
